text:
laura: @releases-bot just flagged the prod promote as BLOCKED, can anyone take a look?
releases-bot: deploy promote main -> prod blocked
releases-bot: reason: manifest mismatch for image redwood/frontend:canary-20260315
releases-bot: pipeline job: promote-prod-20260315 (job id 48291)
laura: looking at the CI logs, the promote job failed pulling a blob from our registry.
ci-bot: build 20260315.4827 produced image digest sha256:abcdef1234567890
ci-bot: publish step returned 500 during blob mount: "blob not found"
sam: I saw this earlier on a self-hosted runner, it pulled manifest with different config sha than the registry index.
nate: registry logs show a "blob mount" error at 2026-03-15T18:12:03Z, likely cross-repo mount failure when the tile cache was evicted.
maya: :eyes: is this the same thing that caused the npm registry token rotation hang last month? could be replication lag between regions.
kevin: quick mitigation options: 1) re-run the single publish job to retry mount, 2) pin promote job to the previous working digest and promote that, 3) rollback canary rollout and pause change window.
olivia: tests for the canary passed, but pushing the new image is currently failing. We should avoid a partial promote.
laura: I'm inclined to pause the promo. Can we promote previous digest (sha256:111122223333) to prod to keep the change window minimal?
sam: we can do that fast — create a pin in the deploy manifest: image: redwood/frontend@sha256:111122223333 and trigger promote. I'll open a PR.
nate: hold on — if we promote an older digest we need to ensure DB migrations aren't tied to new image. No DB migrations in this release.
maya: I'll open an incident and set severity 2, tagging eng-infra and sre. Incident channel: #inc-20260315-blobmount
kevin: long term we should make the publish step tolerate transient mount errors: retry on 5xx + verify manifest digest before marking publish complete.
laura: agree. For now: @sam pin to previous digest and re-run promote. If that succeeds we'll unblock the release and update release notes with a note "rolled back to last successful image due to registry blob mount failure".
sam: PR opened: refs/gh/redwood/frontend/pin-promote-1975012345 -> will trigger a dry-run.
ci-bot: triggered job promote-pin-1975012345, status: queued
releases-bot: deployment hold placed on release 20260315 by laura
olivia: I'll update the release notes once the promote completes, and add an item for the postmortem.
nate: I'll look into runner containerd cache cleanup and registry blob mount logs to find the root cause.
maya: assign eng-infra (nate), eng-platform (kevin) and oncall (maya). I'll schedule a 30m sync in 15 minutes. :calendar:
laura: thanks all. once promote-pin is green, I'll remove hold and ship. If it fails, we'll rollback the rollout and follow incident runbook.
kevin: also adding a short-term retry knob: increase publish retries from 3 to 6 for the next 48h.
sam: promote-pin job is green ✅
releases-bot: promotion completed: redwood/frontend@sha256:111122223333 deployed to prod
laura: removing hold, releasing now. Please follow up on postmortem items.
maya: filing postmortem ticket and linking logs. :spiral_notepad:
